Name: Rubblespawn
Information:
**Rubblespawn**

Born smaller and weaker than other thesite elementals, rubblespawn are numerous and act like scouts and scavengers. They are akin to parasites forming around the true elementals, and opportunistically operate in tandem with their superiors.

Stat Blocks.title: Rubblespawn
languages: understands all Primordial languages but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Burst Adaptation
traits.description: The elemental cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls or saving throws, and will produce adaptations to anything that would cause these issues for as long as they are needed. If such a roll would have disadvantage, however, it cannot have advantage on it either.

traits.name: Uncanny Camouflage
traits.description: While taking the Hide action to remain stealthy, the elemental can take on physical textures that match its surroundings, allowing it to blend into the environment in plain sight. While doing so, they resemble regular rocks, sand, ground, etc. unless closely inspected.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental uses its Gemstone Piercer twice or its Energy Bolt once.

actions.name: Gemstone Piercer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Energy Bolt
actions.description: One target the elemental chooses within 60 feet must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (3d8) force damage and becoming sluggish until the start of the elemental’s next turn on a failure, or no damage on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Uncanny Action
bonus_actions.description: The elemental takes the Dash or Hide action. It may take the Hide action this way in plain sight, and if it rolls less than a total of 18, its result is treated as an 18.
